instruction: Cinematic film still, low-angle medium close-up of a dimly lit hall with classical architectural details. On the right, the dark-haired man in a white t-shirt and harness (R3) looks upward with arms crossed near his face. The blonde man stands behind the dark-haired man, placing a hand near his waist under cool blue ambient light with purple highlights.
